description: Mechanical cross-check of contraction_leaf_blocks.md Parts VI-VIII: the endpoint-location route census (same-branch, different-branch with/without pq edge), the admissible-pair excluded-residue templates, the shared-port arithmetic (2+d_i power-of-two condition), and the distinct-port reduction to a direct admissible pair.
scope_note: Does not re-derive Gao-Huo-Liu-Ma (cited by name). The route census checks use networkx.all_simple_paths for a fully independent enumeration of every simple x-y route in the constructed theta gadgets, confirming both the COUNT and the exact multiset of lengths (including structurally-distinct routes that happen to share a numeric length). The distinct-port reduction check confirms mechanically that R+xy is 2-connected with full internal degree preserved, demonstrating why port-saturation (Part VIII) is not generically needed rather than asserting it. Kept separate from the nine prior contraction verifiers, none of which are touched.
note_on_python_version: Same environment note as prior manifests: requirements.txt/.python-version pin CPython 3.14.6, unavailable in this container; this run used 3.13.12 with networkx==3.6.1 (matches requirements.txt's pin exactly).
detector_agreement: Route census enumeration uses networkx.all_simple_paths (independent of this project's own hand-rolled/networkx-cycle-based checkers used elsewhere), confirming exact route counts and length multisets. 2-connectivity checks use networkx.is_biconnected. 0 disagreements.
completed_range: All gadgets and the full excluded-residue sweep (val in 1..39) processed to completion; a small, deterministic set of explicit illustrative constructions, not a search or census -- consistent with the phase's explicit decision not to launch broad computation.
